LESSON: SIGN READING 14.2.1 FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.2: Sign reading 14.2.1 Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign reading 14.2.1 Fluency, part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one General.

Key inquiry question: Which words have the target sounds? 2. What makes it easy to read fluently?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign reading 14.2.1 Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to Learn: The learner learns independently as they practice timed sign reading on their own.

Values:
Responsibility: Inclusion is enhanced as the learner offers guidance during sign reading activities to those with difficulties.

Link to

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Learner Support Programmes: Mentorship as learners assist each other to sign read fluently.

Link to other Learning Areas

Learner is able to relate knowledge of reading fluency in all the other learning areas.

Suggested Learning Resources

Manual alphabet chart, flash cards, internet, posters, online dictionaries, assistive devices fitted with appropriate technologies such as hearing aids
